   - Collect the required netherite scrap.

7. Craft 5 golden helmets.
   - I'll need 25 gold ingot for these.

8. Craft 16 netherite ingots (as calculated before).

9. Convert 16 netherite ingots into 4 chiseled stone bricks.
   - As mentioned earlier, craft 4 chiseled stone bricks.

10. Craft lodestone from 4 chiseled stone bricks and 1 netherite ingot.
    - Now I have what I need to craft lodestone.
    - Craft 1 lodestone (8 chiseled stone bricks and 1 netherite ingot).

4. Craft 9 netherite blocks (creating netherite ingots along the way).

6. Craft 1 lodestone using 4 chiseled stone bricks and 1 netherite ingot.
